filter.description: Optional. A CEL expression for filtering the results. Policies can be filtered using the expression in the following ways: - Filter by application: `setting.type.matches('^settings/gmail\\..*$')` - Filter by setting type: `setting.type.matches('^.*\\.service_status$')` - Filter by customer: `customer == "customers/{customer}"` Where `customer` is the `id` from the [Admin SDK `Customer` resource](https://developers.google.com/admin-sdk/directory/reference/rest/v1/customers). You may use `customers/my_customer` to specify your own organization. When no `customer` is mentioned it will be default to `customers/my_customer`. You may only filter on policies for a single customer at a time. The above clauses can be combined together in a single filter expression with the `&&` and `||` operators, like in the following example: `customer == "customers/my_customer" && ( setting.type.matches('^settings/gmail\\..*$') || setting.type.matches('^.*\\.service_status$') )`.
